channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: In Palisades visit, Trump officials vow to speed up permits for fire rebuilding
item.description: EPA Chief Lee Zeldin visited Los Angeles together with the head of the Small Business Administration to address what they called unacceptable delays in granting building permits after the last year's devastating fires.

item.title: L.A. simmers under 'dramatic' winter heat wave. How long will it last?
item.description: Several daily temperature records were broken Wednesday as highs across the Los Angeles Basin reached the upper 80s, with the heat felt even along the coast.

item.title: Labor unions urge Gov. Gavin Newsom, California lawmakers to rein in artificial intelligence
item.description: National union leaders urged Gov. Gavin Newsom to protect workers as AI threatens to replace or surveil employees — and warned that failure to do so could hurt his presidential ambitions.

item.title: Disneyland's Haunted Mansion can be rented for weddings, but there is a scary price
item.description: Disneyland announced its famed Haunted Mansion will be available for weddings beginning in July, with the price ranging from $25,000 to $40,000 for use of the mansion’s courtyard.

item.title: In tearful video, Savannah Guthrie addresses possible kidnapper: 'Ready to talk'
item.description: Savannah Guthrie and her two siblings posted a tearful video Wednesday in which they pleaded for the return of their mother, Nancy Guthrie, and asked her possible kidnapper to communicate with them.

item.title: USC names Beong-Soo Kim as its 'next generation' president
item.description: USC on Wednesday said Beong-Soo Kim, the interim campus president since June, would become president.

item.title: What we know about Savannah Guthrie's missing mother
item.description: Officials say they believe Nancy Guthrie, who was last seen Saturday, was taken against her will but haven't identified a suspect or person of interest in the case.

item.title: Bass directed watering down of Palisades fire after-action report, sources say
item.description: One Bass confidant told a source that 'the mayor didn’t tell the truth when she said she had nothing to do with changing the report.'

item.title: IOC continues to have 'full trust' in Casey Wasserman and L.A. Olympic committee
item.description: Amid calls for his ouster for his association with Ghislaine Maxwell, L.A. 2028 Olympic committee chairman Casey Wasserman is greeted warmly by IOC officials in Milan.

item.title: L.A. Olympics head Casey Wasserman withstood a previous scandal. Will he survive the Epstein files?
item.description: LA28's Casey Wasserman is facing calls to resign. He is not responding.
